title.zh: PancakeSwap治理论坛新提案：LP分成拟升至88%，CAKE排放削减约69%
title.en: PancakeSwap治理论坛新提案：LP分成拟升至88%，CAKE排放削减约69%

current_state.zh: PancakeSwap's core team proposed 'The Flip' on its governance forum to raise LP fee share on v3 and Infinity across 11 chains to 88% while cutting post-veCAKE emissions by about 69% to 7,000 CAKE per day, with implementation targeted from November 2026 pending a Snapshot vote.
